facts.activity_file: setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices

assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - spot check of key safeguard at PSV-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-4110 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. PSV-4110 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during routine operation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 13 November 2005 a planned spot check of PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the in-service inspection of pressure equipment not effective.
